scope: Independent read-only review of completed c549 benchmark files; no browser or compilation. No source or benchmark evidence files changed.
executionProvenanceScope: The execution provenance file can later gain the separate focused replay result. Its hash here identifies the bytes read for this benchmark review; benchmark_finished is the component reviewed.

hashChecks.pureTraceAnalysisRerun: Previously rerun directly using the frozen analyzeTextPanTrace export; both results deep-equal the saved analysis. No browser was launched.

measurementBoundaries.dispatchMs: Host Node clock before page.mouse.move until its RPC resolves; includes transport and browser scheduling.
measurementBoundaries.durationMs: Host dispatch start until observation of native renderedFrames advance at the expected camera; the native canvas counter advances inside render before all visual recording finishes.
measurementBoundaries.frameObservationMs: Host duration after mouse dispatch resolves until that same native frame observation.
measurementBoundaries.presentationMs: Host dispatch start until the public native RenderStatistics.frames counter advances; Software2D increments after pixel submission and WebGL2 after flush/disposal. Neither is a Chrome display or GPU completion fence.
measurementBoundaries.settledObservationMs: Host dispatch start through two following requestAnimationFrame callbacks. These callbacks also do not fence actual display completion.
measurementBoundaries.clockDomains: Host phases use Node time; DOM/long-task observations use page time; trace markers are separately bracket-aligned. No subtraction across unaligned clock origins.
measurementBoundaries.traceGroups: Wall interval unions may overlap between nested groups and must not be added as CPU time. Thread tdur is separate and does not measure all SwiftShader workers.

concreteFindings: All 72 normal motions advance one native canvas and one native presentation count with zero prepare/rebuild/projection deltas and 150 cached visible nodes. This supports retained-scene reuse, not a speedup claim.

WebGL2 normal frame observation median is 17.4325435ms, but p95 is 1012.635367ms; normal settling median is 1028.3467065ms and p95 is 1913.189245ms. The small frame median is not evidence of smooth display FPS.

WebGL2 normal slow samples 12 and 24 spend 954.303634ms and 936.424879ms respectively inside input dispatch; observed DOM event-to-capture delays are 945.2ms and 934.4ms. Sample 42 also has 281.066387ms after dispatch.

The longest identifiable main-thread FunctionCall in each trace motion is the FerroUI animation callback (source-map timer.ts:5). Software2D callback wall/tdur spans 74.089-308.591ms / 74.077-238.566ms; WebGL2 spans 47.098-59.543ms / 46.297-58.178ms. The trace cannot attribute these intervals to a particular Rust text-shaping or rendering routine.

The separate exact-ID WebGL2 join record uniquely links all six submitted surfaces to display swaps lasting 762.630-1014.279ms. Motion 3 reaches its two-rAF marker 829.460ms before the matched swap finishes, proving settling is not a display-completion fence.
comparisonLimits: Only one current build is present and comparisons is empty; no matched speedup conclusion is available.
Normal and trace cohorts are separate (36 and 6 per mode); trace timings must not replace normal percentiles.
Trace-enabled execution uses owned BrowserServer WebSocket transport; a trace-off launch is not transport-identical.
Recorded WebGL2 uses SwiftShader, not a measured hardware-GPU throughput configuration.
No OOM increment occurred during this run, but shared-host resource contention is not excluded.
